summary: Added derived Idempotency-Keys (pl-<op>-<sha256[:24]>) for transfer/refund/hold creation and up to 4 attempts with 1/2/4s or Retry-After waits via transport.sleep for GETs, keyed calls and captures; reversals are keyless and read the transfer after an ambiguous failure before resending. Verified with the existing unittest and ad hoc scenarios; no further unit tests added.
